title: Diagnosing Vent Blockages vs Drain Clogs
description: When fixtures gurgle or drain slowly, the root cause is often inadequate ventilation rather than a clogged branch line. A blocked plumbing vent creates negative pressure inside the drainage system, pulling water out of P-traps and causing air to be drawn through fixture traps. Look for symptoms like multi-fixture gurgling or sewer odors returning into the space. Checking roof vents for bird nests, leaves, or ice buildup is a critical troubleshooting step before running a cable down the drain line. Always verify trap seals and local code requirements during vent diagnostics.

Always verify trap seals and local code requirements during vent diagnostics.
